channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. And at noon and Sundays, we take you beyond the headlines to help make sense of what everyone is talking about in politics and beyond with One Thing.

item.title: Revisiting: “This Lost a Lot of People”: RFK Jr.’s Broken Pesticide Promise
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
The position of Surgeon General remains vacant, a federal court struck down vaccine overhauls (for now), and anger from ‘Make America Healthy Again’ activists has some wondering whether Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has lost his grip on the movement that helped propel President Donald Trump back to the White House. We hear from one activist — outraged by an executive order about weedkiller — who says some voters “will not be coming back.” Plus, what’s going on with all the whole hype videos?

---

Guests: Kelly Ryerson, ‘Glyphosate Girl’ & Sarah Owermohle, CNN Health Policy Reporter 

Host/Producer: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: She Clocked in as a Nurse and Clocked Out With a Newborn
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
A Florida nurse’s journey through grief and motherhood took an unexpected turn when she met her future son at work. A rediscovered final draft of Martin Luther King Jr.’s legendary speech reveals that its most famous passage was ad-libbed. An Indigenous-led nonprofit is reclaiming and protecting land on Cape Cod with deep ties to the complicated history of Thanksgiving. Teen surfing prodigy Leihani Zoric made history on the world stage and now she’s dreaming of Olympic gold. Plus, innovative conservation effort aims to protect Pacific walruses and their habitat.

Host/Producer: Krista Bo Polanco 

Producer: Eryn Mathewson 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin
